cases.name: Tiffany Morrison
cases.about: She was a Licensed Massage Therapist and owner at Essential Kneads.
cases.narrative: On 12/20/2023, law enforcement discovered evidence of a shooting in the house and found her remains in a shed located in the back of the house. An affidavit from the Columbiana County Municipal Court stated that authorities received information about a deceased female at the residence and that Tiffany Morrison had been missing since 12/18/2023.

cases.name: Stephanie R. Householder
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Stephanie graduated from Southern Local High School in 2022. She was currently employed as a cashier at the Hot Dog Shoppe in East Liverpool. Stephanie enjoyed being outdoors, especially fishing and riding four-wheelers. She loved talking about her late grandma, Helen, and dedicated her high school graduation to her. Stephanie was looking forward to being a mom and couldn't wait to meet her baby." It also said she had a beloved cat named Raven.
